message: Preview is running on RTX 4060. Fixed three package defects in the local execution copy: missing python3.10-dev for native Python extensions; WSL doctor did not activate the project venv; PyPI gsplat 1.4.0 is a source-only CUDA wheel at runtime, so it was replaced with the official precompiled gsplat 1.4.0+pt21cu121 wheel. 7000-step CUDA training completed without OOM; CPU SOG compression is in progress after the designed no-Vulkan fallback.
